profile.preview.title: Preview of the “started” announce
profile.title: Profile %s
profiles.err.exists: a profile with this name already exists (never overwritten).
profiles.import.help: JSON file in the seedmirage format (schema: 1), 1 MB at most. It is checked by the linter; an existing profile is never overwritten.
profiles.import.title: Import a profile
profiles.title: Client profiles
profiles.updates.help: Queries the public release APIs of the clients (network, on demand only) and reports the families whose latest stable version has no profile.
profiles.updates.title: New versions
profiles.updates.upToDate: No family has a version newer than its profiles.
settings.announceIP.help: Empty: not sent (the tracker already sees your IP).
settings.announceIP.label: Announced IP
settings.autoStart.help: Starts seeding as soon as “serve” starts (at the next launch).
settings.autoStart.label: Start on launch
settings.autoUpdate.help: At the next daily check, downloads the new release, verifies its SHA-256 against the release’s SHA256SUMS, installs it and restarts (clean stop first). Skipped if a torrent was started in the last minute, in a container, or if the folder of the binary is read-only. Needs “Check for updates”.
settings.autoUpdate.label: Install updates automatically
settings.caps.dailyRatioMax.help: Upload over 24 h stays under this ratio times the size; 0 = disabled.
settings.caps.dailyRatioMax.label: Maximum ratio per 24 h
settings.caps.lineMax.help: Cap on the global speed; 0 = unlimited.
settings.caps.lineMax.label: Declared uplink (KiB/s)
settings.caps.perLeecherMax.help: Maximum speed reported for one leecher; 0 = no cap.
settings.caps.perLeecherMax.label: Cap per leecher (KiB/s)
settings.caps.swarmShare.help: Share of the swarm's demand that one torrent can absorb, in ]0 ; 1].
settings.caps.swarmShare.label: Maximum swarm share
settings.keepIdleTorrents.help: Otherwise a torrent without leechers is dropped.
settings.keepIdleTorrents.label: Keep torrents without leechers
settings.maxActiveTorrents.help: Maximum number of torrents announced at the same time. Lowering it stops the most recent ones.
settings.maxActiveTorrents.label: Active torrents
settings.maxDownloadRate.label: Maximum download (KiB/s)
settings.maxTrackerFailures.help: Beyond this, the torrent is dropped. Only applies to torrents started afterwards: running torrents keep the old value.
settings.maxTrackerFailures.label: Tolerated tracker failures
settings.minDownloadRate.label: Minimum download (KiB/s)
settings.port.help: Between 1 and 65535; 0 keeps the current port.
settings.port.label: Announced port
settings.profile.help: Family and version; most recent first.
settings.profile.label: Profile
settings.ratioScope.help: The current session or the cumulative upload of all runs.
settings.ratioScope.label: Ratio computed on
settings.ratioTarget.help: A torrent that reaches this ratio is stopped; 0 = disabled.
settings.ratioTarget.label: Target ratio
settings.rotateIdleAfter.help: Time without leechers (“6h”, “90m”) after which a torrent is replaced; 0 = never. Requires “keep torrents without leechers” and selection by swarm.
settings.rotateIdleAfter.label: Rotation of idle torrents
settings.schedule.enabled.help: Disabled: constant speed and no pauses.
settings.schedule.enabled.label: Enable the schedule
settings.schedule.hourly.help: Multiplies the model speed (0 = silence, 1 = unchanged, 2 = double). Reached on the hour, interpolated between two hours.
settings.schedule.hourly.label: Multiplier per hour
settings.schedule.pauses.help: One per line: day (mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun) then a HH:MM-HH:MM range, for example “mon 22:00-23:30”. A range that crosses midnight (“fri 23:00-02:00”) ends the next day. Torrents are stopped cleanly during the pause, then resumed.
settings.schedule.pauses.label: Pauses
settings.schedule.timezone.help: IANA name (“Europe/Paris”); empty: the machine's time zone (TZ variable in Docker).
settings.schedule.timezone.label: Time zone
settings.sec.advanced.title: Advanced
settings.sec.client.intro: Changing the profile restarts the announces (a “stopped” is sent with the old client).
settings.sec.client.title: Emulated client
settings.sec.network.intro: Changing the port or the announced IP restarts the announces.
settings.sec.network.title: Network
settings.sec.realism.intro: Plausible per-torrent caps and simulated download.
settings.sec.realism.title: Realism
settings.sec.schedule.intro: A daily rhythm: more speed in the evening, less at night, and pauses during which seeding is stopped. Applied immediately.
settings.sec.schedule.title: Hourly schedule
settings.sec.speed.intro: Announced upload rate, in KiB/s. Applied immediately.
settings.sec.speed.title: Speed
settings.sec.torrents.intro: How many torrents are seeded and how they are chosen.
settings.sec.torrents.title: Torrents
settings.selection.help: Swarm: favours torrents that have leechers (scrape); random: simple draw.
settings.selection.label: Torrent selection
settings.simulateDownload.help: A torrent seen for the first time first “downloads”, then seeds. Only applies to torrents added afterwards.
settings.simulateDownload.label: Simulate a download
settings.speedModel.help: Smooth: continuous variation and per-torrent noise; uniform: random draw between the bounds.
settings.speedModel.label: Speed model
settings.title: Settings
settings.updateCheck.help: Once a day, asks GitHub whether a newer release exists (only the version is sent, in the User-Agent). Nothing is downloaded unless you click Update or enable automatic installation. Starting with --no-update-check disables it for the run.
settings.updateCheck.label: Check for updates
settings.uploadRateMax.help: Upper bound; must be at least the minimum.
settings.uploadRateMax.label: Maximum rate (KiB/s)
settings.uploadRateMin.help: Lower bound of the global speed.
settings.uploadRateMin.label: Minimum rate (KiB/s)

stats.hours.title: Upload per hour

stats.ratio.title: Global ratio

stats.title: Statistics
stats.top.title: Top 10 by cumulative upload
stats.trackers.note: Since seedmirage started (not kept between two runs).
stats.trackers.title: Announces per tracker
